title: EDC Orlando 2016 - Announcement
description:
Get ready, Orlando! Insomniac returns to Tinker Field on November 4 & 5, 2016, for yet another glorious weekend of sunshine and good vibes, spectacular art, performers and carnival rides, and the best beats around to dazzle your ears and move your feet.
 
We can’t wait to show you all the surprises we’re planning for you. Stay tuned for more announcements, and we’ll see you in November Under the Electric Sky!
